description: Remove a file or directory. Directories are removed recursively including all descendants. This operation is non-recoverable — there is no undo or trash. Returns the total number of nodes deleted. Errors: ENOENT if the path does not exist, EINVAL if attempting to remove root.

store.description: Named persistent store for cross-session access. Sessions are ephemeral (one per MCP connection); named stores persist indefinitely. Omit to use the session's own namespace.

name: rm
